title: Rockman X4
overview:
In the 22nd century, humans live alongside intelligent robots called Reploids, and the Maverick Hunters stand against those that turn to crime. When the floating city Sky Lagoon comes crashing down on the city below, the Hunters are sent to investigate and are soon caught up in tensions with the Repliforce, a newly formed Reploid army.

Choose to play as X or Zero, each with his own version of the story told through animated movies and in-game scenes. X blasts enemies from a distance with his chargeable X-Buster, earns a new weapon from every boss he beats and can find hidden armor upgrades. Zero fights up close with his Z-Saber and learns new techniques such as an air dash and a double jump.

Take on the stages in any order you like, dash, wall-jump and climb past hazards, and hop onto hover bikes and ride armor along the way. Every boss is weak to a particular weapon or technique, so plan your route carefully.
